text:
Type: tall cabinet with doors and drawers
Use: storing clothes, toys, books and supplies; children's room, bedroom, playroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: painted board, matte black doors, white drawers, cut-out handles
Colors: black, white
Shape: tall narrow cabinet with two black doors on top and three white drawers below, rectangular cut-out pulls, flat top, plinth base, slim and graphic
Feel: graphic, tidy, bold, modern
Goes with: white walls, light wood, black and white textiles; Scandinavian children's rooms or modern bedrooms

product.name: STUVA
product.description: You can keep both hanging and folded clothes in this wardrobe, since it has a clothes rail, shelf and drawers.
